note: implementation_status and commercially_available are derived directly from the frozen Phase 1 audit. No later phase may mark a module COMPLETE or commercially_available here without the implementation, evidence, and passing tests the audit rules require (docs/build-phases/productization/phase-4-packaging.md §1).

pricing.upgrade_pricing_rule: bundle price minus what the node has already paid for owned modules

modules.name: Layer8 TA
modules.description: Multi-timeframe charting and technical analysis: structure, support/resistance, VWAP, volume, volatility, Wyckoff, liquidity zones, confirmation and invalidation.

modules.name: Layer8 Microstructure
modules.description: How the move actually formed, from captured trades and book state.

modules.name: Layer8 Quant
modules.description: Whether a state or mechanism repeats, and whether it carries measurable predictive information.

modules.name: Layer8 Macro
modules.description: What changed in the financial environment outside Bitcoin.

modules.name: Prediction Markets
modules.description: What event markets were pricing around the move.

modules.name: Order Flow
modules.description: Aggressive buying and selling behind the move.

modules.name: Liquidity
modules.description: Where resting liquidity sat and how it changed.

modules.name: Derivatives
modules.description: Perpetuals and futures state: funding, open interest, basis.

modules.name: Options
modules.description: Options positioning and implied volatility context.

modules.name: ETF / Wrapper
modules.description: Spot ETF and wrapper behavior relative to the native market.

modules.name: CME
modules.description: CME Bitcoin futures activity and its timing against other venues.

modules.name: On-Chain
modules.description: Relevant on-chain activity around the event.

modules.name: Arbitrage
modules.description: Cross-venue price dislocations and how they closed.

modules.name: Volatility
modules.description: Realized volatility regime and changes in it.

modules.name: Catalyst
modules.description: Scheduled and unscheduled events near the move.

modules.name: Lead-Lag
modules.description: Which venue or instrument moved first, where the evidence can support an ordering.

modules.name: Market Memory
modules.description: Comparable past states in the node's own recorded history.

modules.name: Data Integrity
modules.description: Feed quality, gaps and clock health behind every answer.

modules.name: Falsification
modules.description: What evidence would prove the current explanation wrong, and whether it appeared.

modules.name: Reconstruction
modules.description: Assembles the timeline of an event from captured evidence.

modules.name: Quant Validation
modules.description: Statistical checks on any claimed edge before it reaches Trade.

modules.name: Execution
modules.description: Order-handling logic downstream of validated research.

modules.name: Arbiter
modules.description: Surfaces and records disagreement between modules instead of resolving it by fiat.

modules.name: Layer8 Trade
modules.description: Downstream of evidence, falsification and quant validation. Cannot rewrite the research record.
